newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds trade picks up in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds trade picks up in afternoon.

text.p: Activity on the European meals and feeds market picked up this afternoon with most of the business done in mid-protein products, market sources said.

"The reasons for the business varied today, with a barely steady dollar boosting demand. Sunmeal traded firmer after a feeling that product hit a bottom, while Argentine soymeal changed hands well below earlier asking prices on profit-taking with a weaker Chicago soymeal futures opening," one broker said.
Some operators said the sell-off in soymeal at some five dollars under the asking price was premature.
"There is little material coming to Europe from South America in the next few weeks, so I don't see why the market will be weak in the near future," one dealer said.
Argentine soymeal pellets traded at $305 a tonne fob Rotterdam for spot material, afloat at $303.50 cif and May/Sept at $260 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
Afloat Argentine sunmeal pellets traded at $144.50 a tonne fob Rotterdam, March at $129.50, April/June at $126 and July/Sept at $130 a tonne cif Rotterdam.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
